meta.title: Passé. — The past, beautifully kept.
meta.description: Create trips, attach geotagged memories, and share a beautiful travel portfolio. Private by default.

hero.subtitle: Passé turns your trips into a living archive — geotagged photos, notes, and moments, arranged into a portfolio worth sharing.
hero.note: Free plan included. No credit card required.

features.heading: Everything you need to preserve your travels
features.subheading: Purpose-built for the way you actually remember trips.

trips.title: Trips as chapters
trips.description: Organise your travels by trip — dates, countries, and a cover that sets the scene.

memories.title: Geotagged memories
memories.description: Pin photos and notes to the exact places they happened. Your story, in order.

portfolio.title: A portfolio, not a feed
portfolio.description: Curate a beautiful public page of your travels and share it with a single link.

how.heading: How it works
how.subheading: Three steps from a trip to a keepsake.

step1.title: Create a trip
step1.description: Name it, set the dates and countries, and give it a cover.

step2.title: Add geotagged memories
step2.description: Drop in photos and notes — each pinned to where it happened.

step3.title: Share your portfolio
step3.description: Publish the trips you choose to a personal page at your own link.

privacy.heading: Your memories are yours first
privacy.description: Everything you add to Passé starts private. Nothing goes public until you deliberately make it so — trip by trip, memory by memory.
privacy.point1: Every trip and memory starts private
privacy.point2: You choose exactly what goes public
privacy.point3: Make anything private again, any time

pricing.subheading: Start free. Upgrade when your archive outgrows it.
